subject: Entitlement enablement & SSO cutover coordination - Luminex Therapeutics
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@luminex.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@luminex.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Entitlement enablement & SSO cutover coordination - Luminex Therapeutics

Hi Jamie / Priya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. This thread is to lock down the technical prerequisites and timeline for the SSO cutover + SCIM-enabled provisioning for Luminex. High-level goals: Migrate SSO to Redwood (SAML), enable SCIM for group and user provisioning (pilot subset), and ensure IP allowlist and service account configuration are in place for the cutover.

Proposed pilot cutover window: 2026-11-06 01:00–04:00 PT (we can shift if your ops prefers a weekend).

Ask list to move forward (please provide as available):
- SAML metadata (IdP XML) or AD FS metadata export (we need entityID, SSO URL, cert thumbprint)
- Current SCIM attribute mapping or a short CSV of user attributes to map (email, givenName, familyName, groups)
- IP ranges to allow from Redwood egress (we'll provide a static set but need your side inbound ranges if you restrict by source)
- Service account email for API calls (e.g., redwood-scim@luminex.com) and whether it needs domain-scoped admin rights
- Preferred test user (email) and a sample test group for pilot (we'll restrict SCIM to that group first)

Attachments that would help: SAML metadata file, network diagram, and a draft SCIM mapping spreadsheet. I'm attaching a short onboarding checklist template (internal) to show the orchestration steps.

Next steps: If you can send the SAML metadata and IP ranges by EOD Friday (2026-10-20) we can schedule a pre-cutover dry run the week of 2026-10-25. Monica (CS) will own the runbook and Karthik will own the implementation tasks on our side. Jonas will review security posture and egress requirements.

Thank you — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: onboarding_checklist_template.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@luminex.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@luminex.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Entitlement enablement & SSO cutover coordination - Luminex Therapeutics

Aisha — thanks for the clear list. Attaching what we have today:
- luminex_saml_metadata.xml (IdP metadata export)
- luminex_ip_ranges.csv (our perimeter egress ranges)

Quick notes inline:
- SCIM mapping: we have a draft but need help mapping a few custom attributes (employeeType and costCenter). I'll attach a draft SCIM workbook by EOD.
- Service account: we can create redwood-scim@luminex.com with a least-privilege role for provisioning; IT prefers to manage creation on our side.
- Group sync: for the pilot, we want to limit SCIM to the group named "rlw-pilot" (contains ~12 users). After pilot success, we can expand.

Can you confirm whether Redwood requires a static source IP for SCIM calls or if mutual TLS is supported? We prefer mutual TLS but can open IP ranges if that's simpler.

Thanks — attaching files now.

—Jamie
Jamie Ortiz
Senior IAM Engineer
Luminex Therapeutics

Attachments: luminex_saml_metadata.xml (application/xml); luminex_ip_ranges.csv (text/csv)

Team — creating an internal runbook and assigning owners. Draft runbook link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/12345-Luminex+Entitlement+Runbook

High-level implementation tasks (owners & target):
1) Create service account in Luminex tenant and confirm credentials/exchange method (Owner: Jamie) — target 2026-10-20
2) Upload IdP metadata and configure SAML entity in staging (Owner: Karthik) — target 2026-10-23
3) SCIM mapping session (joint) to resolve custom attributes and scope to rlw-pilot (Owners: Karthik + Jamie) — target 2026-10-25
4) Network verification: confirm IP allowlist or mTLS configuration for SCIM and SAML ACS endpoints (Owner: Jonas) — target 2026-10-23
5) Dry run cutover in staging with test users (Owner: Aisha/Monica) — target week of 2026-10-25
6) Production cutover (Owner: Monica) — target 2026-11-06 maintenance window (confirm)

Action items I need from Luminex: confirm service account creation approach (delegated or we create), provide the draft SCIM workbook Jamie mentioned, and nominate your network contact for the allowlist/mTLS tests.

I'll maintain the runbook and post updates to the Confluence page; I'll also create a short checklist for the CS playbook that captures rollback steps and verification steps (login test, group membership validation, provisioning events).

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel

Thanks, all. We can provide the SCIM workbook by EOD Friday and will create the redwood-scim@luminex.com service account the same day. Our network lead (Samir Kulkarni) will reach out to Jonas separately; Samir's contact is samir.kulkarni@luminex.com.

Regarding the cutover window: our preference is a weekend window. Can we move the proposed cutover to 2026-11-07 22:00 PT — 2026-11-08 02:00 PT? That gives our on-call team coverage. Please confirm if Redwood can support that window.

Looking forward to the dry run.
